assumptions: Cookie validity: a basket_id cookie is valid when its value parses as a UUID (BasketIdSchema = z.uuid()); a missing or malformed value gets a fresh crypto.randomUUID() and the Set-Cookie header; a well-formed UUID unknown to the store is reused as an empty basket (nothing is written until the first mutation).

400 messages are fixed strings so tests can assert them exactly: body failures → { error: "Invalid request body" }, path-param failures → { error: "Invalid product id" }; a product id is valid when it matches <shopKey>:<sourceId> (ProductIdSchema), so a malformed id is 400 and a well-formed unknown id is 404.

Baskets file shape (design decides): { baskets: { <uuid>: { updatedAt, items: [ { productId, quantity, addedAt } ] } } }; lines are returned in insertion order; addedAt is kept from the first add when quantities merge; clear writes an empty basket; a file that exists but fails BasketsFileSchema throws (500) rather than silently discarding baskets; writes are serialized through an in-process promise queue.

Web state: a React context (BasketProvider in App.tsx, useBasket()) holds one basket object; getBasket() is called once on mount and every mutation stores the basket the client call returns (no second getBasket), which satisfies 'refreshes after every mutation'.

UI states not in the owner's list, recorded in design.md only (no spec scenarios): /basket shows role="status" 'Завантажуємо кошик…' while loading and 'Не вдалося завантажити кошик' on error; a failed 'Додати в кошик' shows role="status" 'Не вдалося додати'; a rejected page mutation leaves the last known basket on screen; the quantity input sends updateBasketItem only for integers 1..99 and keeps other typed text local.
An unavailable line (product null) replaces image/name/unit/prices with 'Товар недоступний' but keeps the 'Кількість' input and 'Видалити' button so the buyer can drop it.
The 'Кошик' heading on /basket is level 2 because the layout's h1 'Organic Catalog' from add-catalog stays on every route.

The catalog-web delta is ADDED-only and has no ## Purpose (the capability belongs to add-catalog); strict validate accepts it. Surfaced conflict: add-catalog's requirement text 'no basket controls' becomes stale — the human should drop that phrase when add-catalog is archived or via a later MODIFIED delta; its scenarios still hold because the button renders no role="status" element until clicked.

createApp's signature becomes createApp({ catalog, basketStore, now = Date.now }); add-catalog's app.test.ts and products.test.ts must pass a temp-directory basket store (task 5.2), and CatalogPage.test.tsx/App.test.tsx must give the mocked getBasket a resolved value (tasks 1.7, 6.2) because the layout now calls it on mount.

Hono setCookie facts (maxAge in seconds; attribute order name=value; Max-Age; Path; HttpOnly; SameSite) were verified against the installed hono 4.13.13 source and Context7 /websites/hono_dev; recorded as row 6 in docs/context7-log.md.

add-catalog's implementation is not yet on disk (apps/api/src/app.ts is still the health-only skeleton); all references to its exports are to its delta specs and design.md, and task 1.1 is a read-only precondition check that stops the loop if add-catalog has not landed.

findings.issue: Scenario "Two lines with totals": the second item (osio line, quantity 1) renders the unit price AND the line sum, and by design D9 both are formatPrice(195) = "195 ₴". The THEN lists "195 ₴" once among "the texts", so a test written from the scenario (`within(item).getByText("195 ₴")`) throws "multiple elements found" against a correct implementation. The expected output is ambiguous about how many times the text appears.
findings.fix: In the THEN for the second item write: `the text "195 ₴" exactly twice (unit price and line sum)`, so the test asserts `within(item).getAllByText("195 ₴")` has length 2. Apply the same wording wherever a line has quantity 1 ("Removing a line": the remaining item shows "195 ₴" twice; "Line without a product" is unaffected because the null line shows no prices).

findings.issue: Requirement "Invalid input is rejected" says a body that is not JSON answers 400, but neither scenario sends a non-JSON body; the design's `c.req.json().catch(() => undefined)` branch has no test.
findings.fix: Add to "Invalid body": `WHEN POST /api/basket/items with header Content-Type: application/json and the raw body `not json` is requested THEN the status is 400 and the body is { error: "Invalid request body" }`.

findings.issue: Requirement "Unavailable product line" states the line SHALL keep its "Кількість" input, but scenario "Line without a product" asserts only "Товар недоступний", the "Видалити" button and the absent image — the kept input is untested.
findings.fix: Add to the THEN: `the second item contains a spinbutton named "Кількість" with value 1` (and, to pin the requirement fully, `two spinbuttons named "Кількість" are rendered`).

findings.issue: Requirement "Header basket link" says every mutation updates N "without a second getBasket() call", but only the mount scenario asserts the call count; the three mutation scenarios ("Changing the quantity updates the line", "Removing a line", "Clearing the basket") and the card scenario never assert that getBasket stayed at one call.
findings.fix: Append `and getBasket was called exactly once` to the THEN of those scenarios (and of "Add from the catalog card" in specs/catalog-web/spec.md).

findings.issue: D7, D8 and D9 introduce user-visible copy marked as assumptions — card failure "Не вдалося додати", page loading "Завантажуємо кошик…", page error "Не вдалося завантажити кошик", and "a rejected mutation leaves the last known basket on screen" — with no scenario in any spec. `.claude/rules/web.md` requires a test beside every component behaviour that asserts a spec scenario, so these tests would have to assert values that exist nowhere in the spec (or the behaviour ships untested).
findings.fix: Either add three scenarios to basket-web / catalog-web (e.g. "Add from the card fails": addToBasket rejects with Error("POST /api/basket/items failed: 404") → first card role="status" shows "Не вдалося додати", header still "Кошик (0)"; "Basket is loading": getBasket pending → role="status" "Завантажуємо кошик…", no list, header "Кошик (0)"; "Basket fails to load": getBasket rejects with Error("GET /api/basket failed: 503") → role="status" "Не вдалося завантажити кошик", no list) and the matching tests in tasks 1.6/1.8, or remove the states from the design so no unspecified copy ships.

findings.issue: Requirement "Change a line's quantity on the page" is conditioned on "an integer 1..99", and design D9 says other input sends nothing, but the only scenario covers the valid value 3; the negative branch (no call, line unchanged) has no assertable scenario.
findings.fix: Add a second WHEN/THEN to "Changing the quantity updates the line": `WHEN the first "Кількість" input is changed to "0" THEN updateBasketItem was not called and the first item still shows "1330 ₴" and the text "Разом: 1525 ₴" is still shown`.

findings.issue: Scenario "Unavailable product counts zero" seeds basket 6d2a1f0c-… "through the store" with two lines but gives no `updatedAt`, which StoredBasketSchema requires — the test must invent a value for the WHEN setup.
findings.fix: Add `updatedAt: "2026-10-04T10:01:00.000Z"` to the seeded basket in the WHEN (same style as the store scenarios).

findings.issue: Task 1.1 greps for the exact strings `export function createCatalogService`, `export function createSnapshotSource` and `export function formatPrice`, but add-catalog's design/tasks never pin the declaration form (only `getProducts` is given a `const` alternative). An `export const formatPrice = (price: number) => …` in add-catalog would falsely stop this change with "cannot start before add-catalog".
findings.fix: Use form-agnostic patterns for all six names, e.g. `export (function|const) createCatalogService`, `export (function|const) createSnapshotSource`, `export (function|const) formatPrice`, `export (async function|function|const) getProducts`, `export const (ProductSchema|routes)`.

findings.issue: Task 6.2 says to add `vi.mocked(getBasket).mockResolvedValue(<empty basket>)` to apps/web/src/pages/CatalogPage.test.tsx "setup only", but that file mocks the client with a factory `vi.mock("../api/client", () => ({ getProducts: vi.fn() }))`; under that factory `getBasket` is undefined and `vi.mocked(getBasket).mockResolvedValue` throws before any assertion runs.
findings.fix: State the factory change explicitly: `vi.mock("../api/client", () => ({ getProducts: vi.fn(), getBasket: vi.fn() }))`, then the beforeEach `getBasketMock.mockResolvedValue({ id: "0f3c9d6e-7a1b-4c2d-9e8f-123456789abc", items: [], totals: { count: 0, sum: 0 } })`.

findings.issue: Task 1.8 lists the BasketPage queries as synchronous `getByRole("heading", …)` and `getByRole("list")`, but design D8 renders the heading "Кошик" already in the loading state, so a test that awaits the heading and then calls `getByRole("list")` / `getByRole("status")` races the resolved getBasket mock (it may see "Завантажуємо кошик…" instead of "Кошик порожній", or no list yet) — a flaky red/green.
findings.fix: Say that each BasketPage test first awaits readiness — `await screen.findByRole("list")` for the line scenarios, `await screen.findByText("Кошик порожній")` for the empty ones — before any `getBy…` assertion, and only then checks `queryByRole("status")`.

findings.issue: Task 5.2 (and proposal.md Impact, design.md D5 / File layout) list only `apps/api/src/app.test.ts` and `apps/api/src/routes/products.test.ts` as the add-catalog tests that call `createApp({ catalog })`. A third one exists on disk: `apps/api/src/lib/catalog.test.ts:145` calls `createApp({ catalog: service })` (the "Runtime switch to snapshot" test). findings.fix: In tasks.md 5.2 add `apps/api/src/lib/catalog.test.ts` to the files that gain `basketStore: createBasketStore(join(mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "baskets-")), "baskets.json"))` (setup only, assertions unchanged); mirror the same third file in proposal.md Impact ("Signature change" bullet), design.md D5 and the File layout block, and in the Risks bullet that counts the setup-only edits.

findings.issue: Task 1.7 says to keep the existing heading test in `apps/web/src/App.test.tsx` green by giving it "the same mocks". That test renders `<App />` bare (no router). `<Outlet />` renders null outside a router, so add-catalog's 6.3 may legitimately leave it bare, but after D6 adds `<Link to="/basket">` react-router 8.4.0 throws "useHref() may be used only in the context of a <Router> component" — mocks alone do not keep it green.
findings.fix: In 1.7 state that the existing heading test must also be rendered through `createMemoryRouter(routes, { initialEntries: ["/"] })` in a `<RouterProvider>` (same render helper as the new test), not as a bare `<App />`, because the header now contains a `<Link>`.

findings.issue: Task 6.2 says to update `apps/web/src/pages/CatalogPage.test.tsx` "setup only" with `vi.mocked(getBasket).mockResolvedValue(<empty basket>)` in a `beforeEach`. That file mocks the client with a factory, `vi.mock("../api/client", () => ({ getProducts: vi.fn() }))`; Vitest 5 wraps factory mocks in a proxy that throws `No "getBasket" export is defined on the "../api/client" mock` on access, so importing `getBasket` for `vi.mocked(...)` fails at module load unless the factory is extended — the edit as written does not work.
findings.fix: In 6.2 spell out the two edits: extend the factory to `() => ({ getProducts: vi.fn(), getBasket: vi.fn() })` and import `getBasket` from `../api/client` next to `getProducts`, then add the `beforeEach` with `vi.mocked(getBasket).mockResolvedValue({ id: "0f3c9d6e-7a1b-4c2d-9e8f-123456789abc", items: [], totals: { count: 0, sum: 0 } })`. Add the same note to design.md File layout line for `CatalogPage.test.tsx`.

findings.issue: Task 1.1's precondition greps are pinned to one declaration form (`export function formatPrice`, `export function createCatalogService`, `export function createSnapshotSource`, `export const routes`, `export const ProductSchema`), but add-catalog's artifacts never fix function-vs-const for these (its tests only import the names). An add-catalog implementation using `export const formatPrice = (price: number) => ...` would trigger the "stop and report that this change cannot start" branch although the dependency is present.
findings.fix: Make the patterns name-based, e.g. `export (function|const) formatPrice`, `export (function|const) createCatalogService`, `export (function|const) createSnapshotSource`, `export (function|const) ProductSchema`, and say the check is "the export exists", not its form.

findings.issue: D7 and D8 add three user-visible Ukrainian texts that are not in the owner's requirements and have no spec scenario: `Не вдалося додати` on a failed add, and on /basket `Завантажуємо кошик…` (loading) and `Не вдалося завантажити кошик` (error), both with `role="status"`. They are marked as assumptions, but `.claude/rules/web.md` requires every user-visible behaviour to have a test asserting a spec scenario, and the owner said not to widen the scope; as written they will ship untested and unapproved.
findings.fix: Either (a) ask the owner and, if accepted, add one scenario per text to basket-web / catalog-web (e.g. "Add from the card fails": `addToBasket` rejects with `Error("POST /api/basket/items failed: 503")` → the first card shows `role="status"` "Не вдалося додати" and the header stays "Кошик (0)"; "Basket page while loading" / "Basket page when getBasket rejects") and the matching tests to 1.6 / 1.8, or (b) drop the error text from D7 (leave the button idle on failure) and keep the /basket loading/error states as the minimum needed to not show "Кошик порожній" prematurely, with scenarios for those two.

findings.issue: D9 says the quantity input's local text state is "reset by `key={`${productId}:${quantity}`}` on the `<li>`". If the key is placed on the `<li>` returned inside `BasketLine`, React does not remount the `BasketLine` component (keys only act among the parent's children), so `useState(String(quantity))` is not reset; and if `BasketPage` maps lines by index, after "Видалити" on the first line the surviving component instance keeps the removed line's typed text ("2") while showing the osio line (quantity 1). The scenarios do not assert the input value after a mutation, so tests stay green while the UI shows a stale quantity.
findings.fix: Reword D9/D8: the key goes on the element in `BasketPage`'s map — `items.map((line) => <BasketLine key={`${line.productId}:${line.quantity}`} line={line} />)` — never inside `BasketLine`; optionally add `toHaveValue(1)` for the remaining spinbutton to the "Removing a line" scenario and test so the reset is asserted.
